quarterly_data.signal: FormFactor's 10-K revenue-by-market table for fiscal 2025 shows Foundry & Logic probe-card revenue of $369,897 thousand (47.1% of revenues), down 3.0% from $381,182 thousand in fiscal 2024, primarily due to weaker demand for probe cards associated with client PC and server microprocessor designs amid reduced customer production; Foundry & Logic fell from 60.9% to 58.0% of Probe Card sales.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 Foundry & Logic $369,897 thousand (47.1% of revenues), -3.0% vs $381,182 thousand; 58.0% of Probe Card sales (60.9% in FY2024)

quarterly_data.signal: FormFactor's 10-K reports fiscal 2025 capital expenditures of $103.7 million, of which $55.0 million related to its new manufacturing facility in Farmers Branch, Texas, and its liquidity assessment includes estimated capital expenditures of $140.0 million to $170.0 million for the ramp of the Farmers Branch manufacturing site. Remaining performance obligations were $30.3 million at December 27, 2025, with approximately 63.7% expected to be recognized in fiscal 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 capex $103.7 million ($55.0 million Farmers Branch); Farmers Branch ramp capex estimate $140.0 million to $170.0 million; RPO $30.3 million
